senses.gloss:
सम्-एद्धृ, धा, m., Ved. one who kindles,
kindling.

समे सम्-ए (-आ-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P.
-ऐति, &c., to come together, approach together,
meet or assemble together, unite together, meet at
or in (with acc. or loc.); to come together with
(with inst.); to go to, enter, go through, march
across (with acc.); to come into competition or
rivalry with, cope with; to join or lead together
(with acc.).

सम्-एत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met together,
assembled, joined or united together, collected, asso-
ciated, agreed, covenanted; encountered, come to
close quarters, come into collision; conjoined, con-
comitant, connected or united with, furnished with,
possessed of, having; come near, approached, ap-
proximated, near.
—समेत-माय, अस्, आ, अम्, fur-
nished with or possessing illusions.

सम्-एत्य, ind. having come together, having
assembled or met together, having held a meeting.

सम्-एयिवस्, आन्, -युषी, अत्, one who has come
together.

समेघलेख स-मेघ-लेख, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-
ing streaks of cloud.

समेज् सम्-एज् cl. 1. P. -एजति, &c., to rise
or move upwards.

समेडी समेडी, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs
attending on Skanda; [cf. भेडि.]

समेध् सम्-एध्, cl. 1. A. -एधते, -एधितुम्,
to prosper greatly, thrive, increase: Caus. -एधयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to prosper or succeed, cause to
increase or swell; to strengthen, make happy or
fortunate^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

सम्-एधित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly increased or
augmented, made to prosper or thrive, strengthened,
strong; united.

समेध स-मेध, अस्, आ, अम्, along with the
sacrifice, having the essence of sacrifice.

सम्-मेलन, अम्, n. the act of meeting together,
assembling, union; mixing with, mixture, blending.
